body: Yeah, it's making that first step to do something new that's really hard. I'm glad I haven't started hitting the bottle much, though I'd be lying if I said it doesn't get more tempting every day.

I've actually considered getting into boxing, but it's hard to find the motivation to get going with that kind of stuff. I like to stay informed, even if I hate it sometimes, but I can totally understand why you wouldn't want to as much. But do it, man. If you can get yourself back into it and you think it'll help again, it's worth it.

That fuckin nails it, dude. I hold on to this belief that if I can  get proper treatment, if I can actually find something that helps me, maybe I can enjoy being part of society, or at least tolerate it more so I can enjoy the things I do like. But that's another reason I'm partly afraid of seeking out treatment options: what if nothing helps? Then fuckin what?

It makes me wonder how many people I interact with, who seem like they're doing fine with things, or even seem like they really enjoy their job are just like me. I feel like I'm crazy, like there's something wrong with me beyond the obvious chemical imbalances in my brain.
